title: Ghostship
description: The iconic 3D platformer brought to modern PCs with enhanced features.

notices.message: Won't launch when the install path contains a non-ASCII character, reporting `Main OTR file not found`. A [fix is pending upstream](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Ghostship/pull/279); renaming the folder works around it, but that detaches the install from PortForge.
